name: groups
description: Progressive disclosure through the MCP Groups extension (progressive-disclosure-wg#19) inside Claude Code: list_groups, open_group and read_skill against a groups server over HTTP, with a group's scoped tools registered on open as deferred definitions.

url.title: Groups server URL
url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a server that implements io.modelcontextprotocol/groups (and, optionally, the Skills extension)

deferScoped.title: Register scoped tools as deferred
deferScoped.description: Keep a group's tools behind ToolSearch after open_group, so disclosing them does not rewrite the cached prompt prefix. Off puts them in the resident tool list.

listSkills.title: List skills in the prompt
listSkills.description: Show the server's skills/list index next to its groups in the system prompt section
